source: Exact board readback and measured memory map from H; never infer from old caps or a Nano.
rules: Record flash partitions, occupied bytes, model/ROMFS bytes and verified free bytes for exact firmware.
Measure runtime heap, tensor arena, frame buffers, stack and switching peaks separately.
Feasible only when artifact fits measured storage and peak RAM retains a 15% reserve of measured usable RAM.
Measure cold/warm load, end-to-end latency, camera behavior and failures on the real Nicla; MAC count is not a speed/energy result.
Use >=10 independently started paired blocks for energy contrasts after G/H.
reserve_fraction_rationale: Team-selected engineering headroom, not a device-capacity fact; freeze before model comparison.

historical_budget_analysis.interpretation: Historical constrained-budget sensitivity only; not asserted as Nicla hardware limits.
